deals.headline: ServiceMaster Reaches Agreement to be Acquired by Clayton, Dubilier & Rice for $15.625 per Share in Cash in a Transaction Valued at $5.5 Billion
deals.summary: An investment group led by CD&R agreed to take ServiceMaster private at $15.625 per share.
deals.evidence: The ServiceMaster Company (NYSE:SVM) announced today that it has entered into a definitive merger agreement to be acquired by an investment group led by Clayton, Dubilier & Rice, Inc. (CD&R) for a total enterprise value of approximately $5.5 billion, including the assumption of existing ServiceMaster debt.

deals.headline: Clayton, Dubilier & Rice and Kohlberg Kravis Roberts to Acquire U.S. Foodservice From Ahold
deals.summary: CD&R and KKR agreed to buy U.S. Foodservice from Royal Ahold as equal partners.
deals.evidence: Clayton, Dubilier & Rice, Inc. (CD&R) and Kohlberg Kravis Roberts & Co. L.P. (KKR) announced today a definitive agreement to acquire U.S. Foodservice, the second largest broadline foodservice distributor in the U.S., from Royal Ahold N.V. (NYSE: AHO). Funds affiliated with CD&R and KKR are equal partners in the transaction, valued at $7.1 billion.

deals.headline: Clayton, Dubilier & Rice to Acquire World’s Leading Materials Testing Business from Bodycote plc

deals.evidence: Clayton, Dubilier & Rice (“CD&R”), a global private equity firm with a strategy of building and growing the businesses in which it invests, today announced a definitive agreement to acquire Bodycote Testing Group (“BTG”), the world’s leading materials testing business, from Bodycote plc. The transaction is valued at approximately £417 million.

deals.headline: NCI Building Systems Announces Agreement With Clayton, Dubilier & Rice
deals.summary: CD&R Fund VIII agreed to invest $250 million in NCI convertible preferred shares as part of a recapitalisation, for a 72% as-converted stake.
deals.evidence: /PRNewswire-FirstCall/ - NCI Building Systems, Inc. (NYSE: NCS) today announced that it has entered into a definitive agreement with Clayton, Dubilier & Rice Fund VIII, L.P. (“the CD&R Fund”), a fund managed by Clayton, Dubilier & Rice, Inc. (“CD&R”), under which the CD&R Fund will invest $250 million in the Company through the purchase of newly issued Convertible Participating Preferred Shares. The CD&R Fund will have a 72% ownership position in the Company on an as-converted, pro-forma basis.

deals.headline: JohnsonDiversey and Clayton, Dublier & Rice Announce Equity Investment and Company Recapitalization

deals.evidence: JohnsonDiversey, Inc. and Clayton Dubilier & Rice, Inc. ("CD&R") today announced an agreement under which a CD&R-managed fund will invest $477 million for a 46 percent equity interest in the company as part of a broader recapitalization transaction valued at $2.6 billion.

deals.headline: JohnsonDiversey and Clayton, Dubilier & Rice Announce Closing of Equity Investment and Company Recapitalization
deals.summary: The JohnsonDiversey recapitalisation closed with a debt package of about $1.9 billion of notes and credit facilities.
deals.evidence: In addition to the CD&R fund investment, the transaction includes a debt financing package of approximately $1.9 billion. The new financing package includes $400 million of privately placed senior notes, $250 million of privately placed holding company PIK notes and $1.25 billion of senior secured credit facilities with a $250 million revolving credit facility.

deals.seller: Metalmark Capital and Scale Venture Partners

deals.headline: Clayton, Dubilier & Rice Completes Acquisition of MAUSER Group

deals.headline: Clayton, Dubilier & Rice Partner with Management to Acquire Motor Fuel Group from Patron Capital in £500m transaction

deals.headline: Univar Inc. Prices Initial Public Offering of Common Stock

deals.headline: Clayton, Dubilier & Rice Invests in Vets First Choice to Accelerate and Expand Services for Veterinary Practices

deals.headline: Beacon Roofing Supply to Acquire Allied Building Products from CRH for $2.625 Billion in Cash

(“Allied”), one of the country’s largest exterior and interior building products distributors, from global diversified building products group CRH plc (LSE: CRH, ISE: CRG, NYSE: CRH) (“CRH”) for $2.625 billion in cash.

deals.headline: Clayton, Dubilier & Rice to Acquire SunSource

deals.headline: Ply Gem Holdings, Inc. Enters into a Definitive Agreement to be Acquired by Clayton, Dubilier & Rice

deals.headline: Clayton, Dubilier & Rice to Acquire Majority Interest in American Greetings

deals.headline: CD&R-Backed Motor Fuel Group Acquires MRH

deals.headline: SunSource to Acquire United Distribution Group

(“UDG”), a leading distributor of fluid conveyance and related products and services primarily serving maintenance, repair and operations (“MRO”) needs across energy, mining and other industrial end markets.

deals.headline: SmileDirectClub Announces $380 Million Equity Private Placement; $3.2 Billion Valuation
